disposition: The lifecycle execution engine is real and focused-tested: the pass deletes expired documents and records evidence, skips documents changed after the plan, refresh consumes its marker leaving expiry untouched, expired documents are invisible before and after the pass, updates never resurrect deleted documents, and the pass is tenant-scoped; execution is caller-driven passes (recorded decision - the synchronous engine owns no clock), and V1's cleanup batch-limit configuration has no counterpart.
